method: ORB (3000 features in the table region of the reference frame), ratio test 0.8, RANSAC homography 3 px; frames with 20 or fewer inliers keep the previous homography (inliers recorded as 0)
H_note: Row-major 3x3 with H[2][2] = 1 omitted. Maps video px of frame i to ref px of the reference frame.
